mainEntity.name: What is the process for custom window installation with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process typically begins with a complimentary consultation at your home in areas like Alameda or Berkeley. We discuss your needs, assess your current windows, and take precise measurements. Following this, we provide a detailed proposal including design options and cost. Once approved, custom windows are manufactured. Finally, our experienced team handles the professional installation, ensuring proper sealing and functionality. Throughout the process, we prioritize clear communication and meticulous workmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process starts with a consultation and measurements, followed by a proposal, custom manufacturing, and professional installation, with clear communication at each step.
